title: Qualys or Nessus: Choosing a Vulnerability Scanner
excerpt: Qualys is a cloud platform for vulnerability management across large estates; Nessus, from Tenable, is one of the most widely used scanners. The right pick depends on your size and how much you need beyond scanning.
verdict: Qualys is the stronger option for large organisations that need broad, centrally managed visibility across complex infrastructure. Nessus is easier to start with and better suited to small and mid-sized security teams that want accurate scanning without a large platform rollout.
